name: @neuropause/workplace
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Wave 10 Enterprise Workspace & Digital Workplace Platform. Composes Waves 1-9 (unchanged) into the daily digital workplace for employees: universal workspaces, navigation, a unified inbox, documents, a knowledge platform, notes, tasks, calendar, chat, meetings, whiteboard, files, forms, workspace AI, a command center, workspace automation, dashboards, a marketplace, a workspace SDK, desktop/mobile experience, and a design system — every service composed on the existing platform (business/industry/AI/automation/governance) without duplicating functionality. Named packages/workplace (not packages/workspace, which already exists as a base package) to preserve the additive/immutable constraint. Workspace runtimes/documents/knowledge/notes/tasks/calendar/chat/whiteboard/files/forms/AI/command/dashboards/marketplace/SDK/governance are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process; email/calendar/video/storage providers and desktop/mobile capabilities are ADAPTER-VERIFIED until configured; real documents/chats/meetings/notes/knowledge/files are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING (registries start empty; never fabricated); and legal retention, government archiving, compliance exports, and real email/video/storage/messaging infrastructure are REGULATED-EXTERNAL and never executed or claimed. One new additive package; every workspace operation is audited on the one chain with a replay id and evidence level.
